full_page.content:
ST. FELIX MONASTERY HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
January 12th
Gles'd be God in all His designs.
God bless you Doris Panyard. I hope this finds you well and that things are brightening up by this time.
I wrote you about a week ago, hoping to reach you next day after George phoned, but spoiled the card and this is the late result.
I received a wire this Morning from my Rev. Brother Edward that our other Rev. brother, Father Maurice Joachim, died this Morning at 6 o'clock. R.I.P. Please pray for the repose of his dear Soul. Thanks be to God he was well pre- pared - over 81 years of a warfare - and probably one thousand of pitched battles ..... last.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
